# The kernel of reduction modulo $p^\ell$

For $\ell\in\mathbb N$, the kernel of reduction $q_\ell:\mathbb Z_p\to\mathbb Z/p^\ell\mathbb Z$ modulo $p^\ell$ is $H_\ell$.

*Proof sketch.* The kernel of reduction is the ideal generated by $p^\ell$, which is $\{a : p^\ell\mid a\}=H_\ell$.
